svg.title: XingHuo NPU architecture
svg.desc: Tile overview and expanded NPU core. Functional colors; one synchronous clock domain. Shared RAM is provided by the SoC outside the Tile. The lower panel expands the same core shown above, not a second instance.
svg.text: Read data also feeds host / display directly; observation and handshake return wires are omitted.
XingHuo_NPU · the same core as in (a)
